faqs.q: Do I need to book in advance?
faqs.a: Walk-ins are welcome, but we recommend booking online or via WhatsApp to guarantee your preferred time. Bookings are confirmed within 2 hours.
No upfront payment is needed. Simply pay at the spa before your treatment — we accept cash (THB), PromptPay, and major payment methods.

faqs.q: Where is Crystal Aura Massage & Spa located?
faqs.a: We are at 22 Nimmana Haeminda Rd Lane 13, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai 50200, in the heart of the Nimman area.
We are open every day from 09:00 to 23:30, including weekends and holidays.
